description: Visualise AP-64's nearest annotated-AMP neighbours in descriptor space and their identities
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.rcParams.update({"font.size":9,"axes.spines.top":False,"axes.spines.right":False})
AMP=pd.read_csv("amp_reference_with_descriptors.csv"); nn=pd.read_csv("ap64_nearest_neighbours.csv")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5.6),gridspec_kw=dict(width_ratios=[1,1.35],wspace=0.35))

ax=axes[0]
ax.scatter(AMP.net_q,AMP.uH18,s=5,color="#d5dbe1",label="1,451 UniProt AMPs")
ax.scatter(nn.net_q,nn.uH18,s=45,color="#e67e22",edgecolor="k",lw=.4,zorder=3,
           label="15 nearest neighbours of AP-64")
ax.scatter(-6.10,0.602,s=140,marker="*",color="#c0392b",edgecolor="k",lw=.6,zorder=4,label="AP-64 (C5orf46)")
for nm,q,u in [("LL-37",5.86,0.894),("magainin-2",2.90,0.506),("cecropin-A",5.86,0.658)]:
    ax.scatter(q,u,s=55,color="#2471a3",edgecolor="k",lw=.4,zorder=3)
    ax.annotate(nm,(q,u),(6,4),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=8,color="#2471a3")
ax.axvline(0,color="k",lw=.9,ls="--"); ax.set_ylim(0,1.1)
ax.set_xlabel("net charge at pH 7.4"); ax.set_ylabel("max hydrophobic moment uH")
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=8,loc="upper right")
ax.set_title("A   AP-64's nearest neighbours in 8-descriptor space\n      are all net-anionic peptides",loc="left",fontweight="bold")

ax=axes[1]
lab=[f"{r.desc[:34]}  ({r.org.split()[0][:9]})" for r in nn.itertuples()]
y=np.arange(len(nn))[::-1]
ax.barh(y,nn.net_q,color="#e67e22",edgecolor="k",lw=.3)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(-6.10,color="#c0392b",ls="--",lw=1.6)
ax.text(-6.3,len(nn)-0.3,"AP-64  -6.1",ha="right",color="#c0392b",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel("net charge at pH 7.4"); ax.set_xlim(-8,0.6)
ax.set_title("B   Identity of the 15 nearest annotated AMPs\n      (chromogranin A / proenkephalin / haptoglobin fragments,\n      insect anionic AMPs, leech theromyzin)",loc="left",fontweight="bold")
plt.show()
